name: miragea-voiceover-mcp
display_name: Miragea AI Voiceover MCP (Text to Speech, Podcast Generator, Subtitles)
description: AI voiceover MCP: text to speech, two-host podcast & multi-speaker dubbing (WAV+SRT), subtitles, via Miragea.
long_description: AI voiceover / text to speech / multi-speaker dialogue voiceover (two-host podcast, multi-character dubbing) / subtitle generation. Start with get_capabilities and list_voices; use text_to_speech for a single text, dialogue_voiceover for scripts (WAV + SRT + manifest.json), generate_subtitles for audio/video to SRT. Generation tools use account credits, so confirm the script and voices with the user first. Clone a voice only with the speaker's consent, and label AI-generated audio where it is published.
